title: A History of Human Greed & Dark Tournaments (YuYu Hakusho analysis)
summary: A video essay on YuYu Hakusho's Dark Tournament arc. NH argues that the story's real evil comes from humans driven by money, not from demons. He reads Sakyo's plan to open the demon realm as the nihilism of an elite who has grown bored of wealth.
claims: In YuYu Hakusho most of the darkness comes from humans rather than demons, e.g. Tarukane torturing a girl whose tears become jewels
Money is the god humans and demons share; humans who drop their morals for power are more sinful because they chose it with free will
Money can't buy happiness but it buys pleasure; enormous wealth leads to depravity, as with the Black Black Club betting on death matches
The Dark Tournament is run by a crime syndicate; the human owners profit most while the fighters are expendable
In any organization rules favor whoever wrote them; at the tournament, victory is often decided by words rather than swords
Sakyo, bored of wealth and chasing excitement, wants to open a rift to the demon realm; an elite revolts only when the gains are huge and the drive is strong
Extreme nihilism is self-destructive: if lives don't matter, life itself doesn't, and the darkness eventually turns on its owner
The Dark Tournament was destroyed by the same greed that created it
